info.title: PageTranslateAI - Document Translation
info.description: Translate PDF, scanned PDF, DOCX, EPUB and images into 70+ languages while preserving layout. Use your own PageTranslate account and API key. Upload is free; review the returned quote before explicitly starting a translation with words already in your account. This integration never charges a card. Limits: 100 MB and 1,000 PDF pages. https://pagetranslate.ai/api

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Upload, explicitly start, follow and download document translations

post.summary: Upload a document and get its quote
post.description: Does not start translation. Send PDF, DOCX, EPUB or a supported image and a target language code, such as es, fr or pt-BR. Review the quote and call getTranslation before deciding to start. Uploads up to 100 MB; PDFs up to 1,000 pages.

file.description: PDF, DOCX, EPUB, PNG, JPG, WEBP, TIFF, BMP or GIF document

requested_language.description: Target language code; pt-BR for Brazilian Portuguese

200.description: Document accepted; translation has not started

429.description: Upload rate limit reached; retry later

get.summary: Get a translation's status and word count
get.description: Poll about every 30 seconds while processing. A cost_cents value of zero indicates the current quote is covered by the account's word balance; start can still refuse if that balance changes. Only status=completed is ready to download.

403.description: The job belongs to another account

post.summary: Start an explicitly confirmed translation using your word balance
post.description: Only call after the user confirms the word count and quote. Spends existing word balance and cannot be undone. If the balance is insufficient, the request fails; no card is charged. Do not automatically retry a refused start.

400.description: Balance does not cover this document, or the job cannot be started

403.description: The job belongs to another account

409.description: Already queued, or payment fulfillment is still processing; inspect job status

post.summary: Get a one-hour download link for a completed translation
post.description: Prefix download_path with https://api.pagetranslate.ai (not the API /api/v1 base) to obtain the full download URL. Anyone holding this temporary link can download that translated document. Do not publish real signed links in templates or logs.

PageTranslateKey.description: Create your own API key at https://pagetranslate.ai/dashboard/api-keys. Send Authorization: Bearer pt_live_YOUR_KEY. Never use a shared provider key.

JobId.name: job_id
JobId.description: The job_id returned by uploadDocument or listTranslations

Unauthorized.description: Missing, revoked or invalid PageTranslate bearer API key

InvalidRequest.description: Invalid file, unsupported language or invalid request parameters
